summary: The developer preview of APES Newsroom now runs on WampServer at http://apes-newsroom.test instead of Laragon. Nothing changes for readers, subscribers or staff on the live site.
detailed_changes: The local development guide describes the WampServer preview: Apache 2.4 with PHP 8.4 serving the app at http://apes-newsroom.test, a virtual host and hosts entry, APP_URL, and Vite live reload from npm run dev (#751).
The agent guide and README point to the WampServer preview, and Laragon is no longer part of local development or testing (#751).
The passkeys notes explain that passkeys only work at http://localhost:8000 locally, because browsers refuse them on a plain-http .test address (#751).
affected_areas: Page or route: none (developer documentation only)
User groups affected: developers working on the Newsroom
Internal impact: local preview and testing run on WampServer instead of Laragon
